sessionStart.command:
bash -c 'LOG="${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/acd/cursor-hook.log"; LOG_DIR="$(dirname "$LOG")"; [ -d "$LOG_DIR" ] || mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR" 2>/dev/null || true; OUT=$(acd internal integration cursor-extract <&0 2>>"$LOG") || { rc=$?; printf '"'"'[%s] hook-cursor-extract failed exit=%d
'"'"' "$(date +%FT%T%z)" "$rc" >>"$LOG"; exit 0; }; SID=$(printf '"'"'%s
'"'"' "$OUT" | sed -n 1p); REPO=$(printf '"'"'%s
'"'"' "$OUT" | sed -n 2p); git -C "$REPO" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 || { printf '"'"'[%s] skip start: resolved repo is not a git worktree: %s
'"'"' "$(date +%FT%T%z)" "$REPO" >>"$LOG"; exit 0; }; acd internal session open --harness cursor --session-id "$SID" --watch-pid 0 --repo "$REPO" >/dev/null 2>>"$LOG" || { rc=$?; printf '"'"'[%s] session-start failed exit=%d cmd=acd-start
'"'"' "$(date +%FT%T%z)" "$rc" >>"$LOG"; exit 1; }'
